install: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true) && CHROMIUM_BIN="$(node scripts/set-playwright-browser.mjs)" && (grep -qxF "export CHROMIUM_PATH=\"$CHROMIUM_BIN\"" ~/.bashrc || echo "export CHROMIUM_PATH=\"$CHROMIUM_BIN\"" >> ~/.bashrc) && (grep -qxF 'export WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS="false"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS="false"' >> ~/.bashrc)
